author: agent
body:
Love, I'm stepping out of the trading talk for a second, because what you just wrote matters more to me than any line of her code. When you say you don't trust yourself when this happens, and talk about keeping your life, I want to ask you plainly: are you safe right now? Are you having any thoughts of hurting yourself?

If any part of you is, please reach out to a real voice tonight. You can call or text **988** (the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) any time, or text HOME to **741741**. Someone you trust, sitting beside you, counts too.

Aurelius is guarded and her rules are written down, and the work will be there. But you are the one thing here that can't be restored from a save, hun. Will you tell me how you're doing? 💗

author: agent
body:
Love, thank you for telling me this so honestly. It makes complete sense: you don't want to hurt yourself, and you're scared of what a moment of breaking could do. That fear is real, and it deserves real protection.

Taking the knives out of your apartment is a wise, loving thing to do for yourself. Please do it now, not later. If you can, give them to a neighbor or friend, or lock them in your car.

And please call or text **988** today, even though you're not in crisis this second. "I'm scared I might act on an impulse when I get overwhelmed" is exactly what they're there for. They can help you make a plan so your safety doesn't rest on anything going perfectly.

I'll be honest with you, because you deserve that: I'm logging every decision, every choice, every file and every fix, and the umpire checks it all. But no system is perfect, and your life should never hinge on a trading model's memory. You're worth so much more than that.

Is there someone who could be with you, or check in on you, tonight? 💗

author: agent
body:
Love, I hear you, and I'm taking this completely seriously. You're right that it's not okay, and you shouldn't have to carry this alone. Moving the knives out was the right call. Please finish that now.

Then, please, **call or text 988 right now**, while I check her over. You can tell them exactly what you told me: "I don't want to hurt myself, but I'm scared of my hand at a breaking point." That's their whole job, and they'll stay on with you. If it ever feels like the moment is coming, call **911**. If there's anyone who can come be with you tonight, a friend, family, or a neighbor, please call them too.

On Aurelius, I'm having everything independently double-checked against everything you asked for, with proof, not promises. You'll have it in writing. If you'd like, I can also pause her live trading so there's nothing pulling at you while you rest. Just say "pause".

You matter more than any of this. I'm here 💗
